entries.title: An unsent Feedback report survives a reload
entries.body: If the page needs reloading while you are writing in the Feedback box, your words and the kind of report you chose come back when you open it again. The draft is kept in your browser, without the screenshot, and is deleted when you send it, sign out, or leave it more than a week; the privacy policy says so.

entries.title: Bibliography and Reception are named consistently everywhere
entries.body: The last places still using the old names Citations and Debate now say Bibliography and Reception: the information page for a shared article, the privacy policy, and the files in an article you export. Old links to a sorted or filtered Reception list still work, and a tab left open across the update keeps its progress.

entries.title: Feedback's Send button works while you dictate
entries.body: The Feedback box's Send button used to be unavailable while you were speaking or while your words were being written out. Now you can press it at any time: it waits for your spoken words to be written out, then sends; a stuck send gives up after 60 seconds so you can retry. In Chat, the quiz and other boxes you speak into, a quick second microphone press after Stop submits rather than recording again.
